name: screen-call
description: Video-call style overlay: chat with Claude and see Claude's cursor on your screen

overlay_chat.title: Chat in the overlay
overlay_chat.description: Type and send voice messages in the overlay. Needs Claude Code started with the channels flag (see README). Off: chat in the terminal; the overlay keeps Claude's cursor, drawings and messages.

recording_mode.title: Recording mode
recording_mode.description: Let screen recorders and screen sharing (OBS, Snipping Tool, Teams) capture the overlay. Claude's own screenshots will then show its drawings too.
